normalize_gtest_json_output: normalize a Google Test JSON output object by replacing transient time, timestamp, and stack trace values with wildcards
normalize_time_fields: normalize time fields in a dict by replacing duration strings like 1.23s with a wildcard
normalize_timestamp_fields: normalize timestamp fields in a dict by replacing ISO 8601 timestamps with a wildcard
normalize_failure_messages: normalize failure messages by stripping line numbers and replacing stack traces with a wildcard
normalize_nested_json_structures: recursively normalize nested dicts and lists in Google Test JSON output to remove transient information
